opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations working with disability, awarding grants to capital projects such as new build, refurbishment or equipment, focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Provides grants for charities working in mental health for capital projects, emphasizing training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports charities providing care for older people, especially those with neurodegenerative conditions, with capital grants for new build, refurbishment or equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority operating a historic site; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations managing historic buildings or landscapes of national significance, funding conservation, restoration, interpretation and education spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or hospice operating within the NHS; UK only
opportunities.summary: Provides capital grants for hospices and palliative care organisations for new buildings, refurbishment or equipment to improve patient and family care.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority operating a library or archive with nationally significant collections; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports libraries and archives to improve collection storage, research, education or interpretation spaces, focusing on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority operating a museum or gallery with nationally significant collections; UK only
opportunities.summary: Provides capital grants to museums and galleries for refurbishing or creating new galleries, and occasionally education spaces, to improve display and interpretation of collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority focused on professional performing arts; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports performing arts organisations to improve training and education facilities through new build, refurbishment or major equipment grants.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity, local authority or university; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations with scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through refurbishment, new galleries or education spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment) / £15,000 – £100,000 (new build & refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State‑funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK meeting performance criteria
opportunities.summary: Provides capital grants to high‑achieving state secondary schools and sixth form colleges to improve specialist teaching spaces and equipment for selected subjects.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, funding new build, refurbishment or equipment projects.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1,000,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research‑intensive universities or research institutions in the UK
opportunities.summary: Provides capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment or major equipment to enhance research infrastructure, and occasionally for public engagement or library improvements.
